name: v3_cgrid_tailr2_coarse

topology.method_scope: Independent primal SU2 geometry/edge audit. High wall aspect ratio is not a failure by itself. This does not directly audit SU2 node-centered dual-volume orthogonality; no after-result skew cutoff was introduced.

geometry.discrete_boundary: Straight CFD wall segments connecting exact r2 B-spline sample points; finite chord error remains.

source_design_audit: Explicit distributions and actual column measurements, not a whole-layer conclusion inferred from y+.
